candidates.statement: Effective Date: 06/23/2022 Page 2 of 3 • Develop increased scientific expertise within OB • Provide opportunities for professional mentorship within OB • Provide opportunities to work with fellow OB members for the betterment of OB PROCEDURES To create an IG, an individual or a group of individuals should do the following:
candidates.context: • Support professional development based on scientific interests 1. Prepare a one-to-two-page proposal requesting to create the IG that includes: the rationale, goals and/or deliverables, planned duration of the IG (which may depend on the deliverables), and a list of the intended initial IG members.

candidates.statement: 3. Obtain approval for creation of the IG from the appropriate manager. If the IG is within a division, approval should be obtained from the OB Division Director. For within-division IGs focused on topics that are broadly relevant to the office and/or may overlap with ongoing OB working group or committee efforts, the Division Director should discuss with office leadership prior to approval. If the IG is across divisions within OB, approval should be obtained from the OB Office Director, or a designee. A presentation of the proposal to Division or Office leadership may be requested. Proposals with a purpose linked to OB strategic plan initiatives are more likely to get approved.
candidates.context: 2. Obtain approval for participation of all individuals in the IG from their immediate supervisors or Division Directors(following division procedures). Other operational procedures include the following:

candidates.statement: 2. Each IG should decide on organizational structure (e.g., any sub-teams), term duration for committee members (this may not always apply), leads or points of contact, and any additional positions. Rotation of committee members and/or responsibilities is encouraged.
candidates.context: 1. The Division or Office Director may assign an OB member, or a group of OB members (e.g., a steering committee), to oversee or consult with the IG. 3. The maximum amount of official work hours per pay period that an OB member can use to work on IG projects is determined by the member’s supervisor and/or Division Director. Continued participation in IG activities is dependent on the member getting other assigned work completed.

candidates.statement: 4. The approved IGs should maintain a wiki page within the OB Wiki. This wiki page should include the proposal, list of members, organizational structure, activities, and any outcomes and progress of the IG. The IG should assign the responsibility of maintaining the IG wiki page to a member or members.
